instruction: Rate the review's overall sentiment on this scale. Use the level the text supports best.

0: 1 star: very negative.definition: The review expresses strong dissatisfaction with extreme criticism, indicating a complete failure in service, product, or experience, with no redeeming qualities mentioned.
examples: Terrible service, food was cold and inedible, and the staff was rude. I will never come back.
Worst experience of my life. The place was filthy, and they overcharged me. Avoid at all costs.

1: 2 stars: negative.definition: The review is predominantly critical, mentioning significant problems or disappointments, but may include minor positive remarks that do not outweigh the overall negative impression.
examples: The food was okay, but the wait took over an hour and the server forgot our drinks.
I almost left after 10 minutes due to poor cleanliness, but the manager apologized and we stayed.

2: 3 stars: mixed or neutral.definition: The review presents a balance of positive and negative elements or expresses mild satisfaction without enthusiasm, making it unclear whether the experience was ultimately good or bad.
examples: The restaurant is average—some dishes were good, others were bland, and the service was slow but polite.
It wasn't bad, but nothing stood out. The price was fair for what we got.

3: 4 stars: positive.definition: The review is clearly favorable, highlighting several good aspects and expressing satisfaction, though it stops short of calling the experience exceptional or perfect.
examples: Great food and friendly staff! Only the wait time was a bit long, but everything else was excellent.
I enjoyed my meal and the atmosphere was cozy. Definitely coming back.

4: 5 stars: very positive.definition: The review is highly enthusiastic, praising nearly every aspect of the experience with superlative language and strong recommendations, indicating exceptional quality or service.
examples: Absolutely amazing! Best meal I've ever had—the service, ambiance, and food were all perfect.
Outstanding in every way. I can't recommend this place enough. A five-star experience!
